answer: Put breath-pattern acoustic fingerprint at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 554 aliases need 554 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. Trust the karst of the check, count the saffron of the cost, and read the violet of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
